environment.notes: Record mount changes, target/fixture IDs, and any rework. Re-run after collision, mount movement, camera replacement, or LiDAR/sensor replacement.

boom_geometry.notes: Surveyed offsets that turn PLC length-sensor readings (pivot angle, extension) plus platform tilt into the MID-360 height above ground. Source of truth: the kinematic URDF. cutting_arm_lift_offset_m includes the 0.30 m LiDAR mount on cutting_arm_base_link and must be held constant during a scan.

acceptance.notes: Set site safety requirements before collecting results; no default limit is safe to assume.
